ex.en: Roll up your right sleeve.
ex.zh: 把你右邊的袖子捲起來。

ex.en: The men are wearing short sleeve shirts.
ex.zh: 那些男人穿著短袖襯衫。

sleeve.zh: up one's sleeve：暗藏（妙計、王牌）

ex.en: I still have a few ideas up my sleeve.
ex.zh: 我還有幾個點子留著沒說。

ex.en: She always has a surprise up her sleeve.
ex.zh: 她總是暗藏驚喜。

ex.en: For some reason, I feel sleepy when I start studying.
ex.zh: 不知道為什麼，我一開始讀書就想睡。

ex.en: We were very sleepy the next morning.
ex.zh: 隔天早上我們都很睏。

ex.en: I'm too sleepy to do my homework.
ex.zh: 我太睏了，沒辦法寫功課。

ex.en: We stayed in a sleepy fishing village.
ex.zh: 我們住在一個寧靜的小漁村。

ex.en: It's a sleepy town with few tourists.
ex.zh: 那是個觀光客很少的寧靜小鎮。

ex.en: Do you have any free slots on Thursday afternoon?
ex.zh: 你週四下午有空檔嗎？

ex.en: The meeting has been moved to the 3 p.m. slot.
ex.zh: 會議改到下午三點的時段。

ex.en: Insert a coin into the slot.
ex.zh: 把硬幣投入投幣口。

ex.en: The memory card goes into this slot.
ex.zh: 記憶卡插進這個插槽。

slot.zh: 安排進、安插（常用 slot in）

ex.en: I can slot you in at two o'clock.
ex.zh: 我可以把你排在兩點。

ex.en: We managed to slot the meeting into his schedule.
ex.zh: 我們設法把會議排進他的行程。

ex.en: The industry is in a slump.
ex.zh: 這個產業正處於低迷期。

ex.en: Sales suffered a slump in the third quarter.
ex.zh: 第三季銷售大幅下滑。

ex.en: The Taiwanese dollar appreciated, causing Taiwanese exports to slump.
ex.zh: 新台幣升值，導致台灣的出口衰退。

ex.en: Profits slumped by 20 percent last year.
ex.zh: 去年獲利暴跌了兩成。

ex.en: He slumped into the chair after the long meeting.
ex.zh: 開完冗長的會議後，他癱坐在椅子上。

ex.en: She slumped on the sofa, exhausted.
ex.zh: 她累得癱在沙發上。

ex.en: There has been a slowdown in economic growth.
ex.zh: 經濟成長出現放緩。

ex.en: The slowdown in sales worried investors.
ex.zh: 銷售趨緩讓投資人很擔心。

ex.en: The store slashed prices by 50 percent.
ex.zh: 這家店的價格砍了五成。

ex.en: The marketing budget was slashed this year.
ex.zh: 今年的行銷預算被大幅刪減。

ex.en: Use a slash between the day and the month.
ex.zh: 日期和月份之間用斜線隔開。

ex.en: The web address ends with a slash.
ex.zh: 這個網址以斜線結尾。

ex.en: Business is usually slack in winter.
ex.zh: 冬天的生意通常比較清淡。

ex.en: The rope is too slack.
ex.zh: 這條繩子太鬆了。

slack.zh: cut someone some slack：體諒某人、別太苛責

ex.en: Cut him some slack; it's his first day.
ex.zh: 體諒他一下吧，今天是他第一天上班。

ex.en: My boss cut me some slack because I was sick.
ex.zh: 我生病了，所以老闆沒有太要求我。

slack.zh: pick up the slack：接手、補上空缺

ex.en: When Amy left, Tom picked up the slack.
ex.zh: Amy 離開後，Tom 接手了她的工作。

ex.en: We hired more staff to pick up the slack.
ex.zh: 我們多雇了人手來補足人力。

ex.en: She has blonde hair and a slim figure.
ex.zh: 她有一頭金髮，身材苗條。

ex.en: I am getting slim!
ex.zh: 我變苗條了！

ex.en: Our chances of winning are slim.
ex.zh: 我們獲勝的機會很渺茫。

ex.en: There is only a slim chance of rain today.
ex.zh: 今天下雨的機率很低。

ex.en: The company plans to slim down its workforce.
ex.zh: 公司計劃縮減人力。

ex.en: We slimmed down the menu to save costs.
ex.zh: 我們精簡了菜單以節省成本。

ex.en: The schedule is only slightly affected by this delay.
ex.zh: 這次延誤對進度只有些微影響。

ex.en: He was slightly injured in a traffic accident.
ex.zh: 他在車禍中受了輕傷。

ex.en: You may be right, but we have a slightly different opinion.
ex.zh: 你也許是對的，但我們的看法稍有不同。

ex.en: The ship made slow progress against the strong wind.
ex.zh: 這艘船頂著強風緩慢前進。

ex.en: Stop inhaling your food. You should eat a little slower.
ex.zh: 別狼吞虎嚥，你應該吃慢一點。

ex.en: The internet connection is really slow today.
ex.zh: 今天網路連線真的很慢。

ex.en: What happened? The car's slowing down.
ex.zh: 怎麼了？車子在減速。

ex.en: The train slowed and blared its horn as it approached the railway crossing.
ex.zh: 火車接近平交道時減速並鳴笛。

ex.en: Sales have slowed in recent months.
ex.zh: 最近幾個月銷售趨緩。

ex.en: Business is always slow in January.
ex.zh: 一月的生意總是很清淡。

ex.en: My watch is five minutes slow.
ex.zh: 我的錶慢了五分鐘。

ex.en: Could you please speak a little bit more slowly?
ex.zh: 可以請你說慢一點嗎？

ex.en: My Korean is not very good. Please speak slowly.
ex.zh: 我的韓文不太好，請說慢一點。

ex.en: I am slowly adjusting to the harsh climate here.
ex.zh: 我正慢慢適應這裡嚴酷的氣候。

ex.en: Roger slipped on the ice and hurt his leg.
ex.zh: 羅傑在冰上滑倒，摔傷了腿。

ex.en: I slipped and fell down the stairs.
ex.zh: 我腳一滑，從樓梯上摔了下來。

ex.en: Tom slipped out of the classroom.
ex.zh: 湯姆溜出了教室。

ex.en: She slipped out of the meeting early.
ex.zh: 她提早從會議中悄悄溜走了。

ex.en: The sales are slipping.
ex.zh: 銷售量正在下滑。

ex.en: The company's profits slipped by 5% last quarter.
ex.zh: 公司上一季的獲利下滑了 5%。

ex.en: Please fill out a deposit slip at the counter.
ex.zh: 請在櫃檯填寫存款單。

ex.en: He wrote his number on a slip of paper.
ex.zh: 他把電話號碼寫在一張小紙條上。

slip.zh: 小失誤、疏忽（slip of the tongue 口誤）

ex.en: A slip of the tongue often brings about unexpected results.
ex.zh: 一時口誤常會帶來意想不到的後果。

ex.en: Sorry, it was just a slip of the tongue.
ex.zh: 抱歉，那只是口誤而已。

ex.en: Having a slight headache, I went to bed early.
ex.zh: 我有點頭痛，所以早早就上床睡覺了。

ex.en: We had a slight difference of opinion.
ex.zh: 我們的意見有一點不同。

ex.en: Without the slightest hesitation, he sold his own car.
ex.zh: 他毫不猶豫地賣掉了自己的車。

ex.en: I don't have the slightest intention of retiring.
ex.zh: 我一點都沒有退休的打算。

ex.en: Lincoln set the slaves free.
ex.zh: 林肯解放了奴隸。

ex.en: He treats me like his slave.
ex.zh: 他把我當奴隸一樣使喚。

ex.en: She is a slave of fashion.
ex.zh: 她是潮流的奴隸。

ex.en: Don't be a slave to your phone.
ex.zh: 別當手機的奴隸。

ex.en: The path zigzagged up the steep slope.
ex.zh: 這條小路沿著陡坡蜿蜒而上。

ex.en: We climbed a sharp slope.
ex.zh: 我們爬上一道陡坡。

ex.en: Beginners should ski on the easy slopes.
ex.zh: 初學者應該在簡單的坡道上滑雪。

ex.en: The garden slopes down to the river.
ex.zh: 花園朝河邊傾斜而下。

ex.en: The roof slopes steeply on one side.
ex.zh: 屋頂有一側坡度很陡。

ex.en: Cut the meat into thin slices.
ex.zh: 把肉切成薄片。

ex.en: Will you have another slice of pie?
ex.zh: 你要再來一塊派嗎？

ex.en: Two slices of pizza please.
ex.zh: 請給我兩片披薩。

ex.en: I want to slice these potatoes into strips.
ex.zh: 我想把這些馬鈴薯切成條。

ex.en: Could you slice the tomatoes for the salad?
ex.zh: 你可以把番茄切片做沙拉嗎？

ex.en: The company wants a bigger slice of the market.
ex.zh: 這家公司想分得更大的市場份額。

ex.en: Everyone wants a slice of the profits.
ex.zh: 每個人都想分一杯羹。

ex.en: The floor is made of concrete slabs.
ex.zh: 地板是用水泥板鋪成的。

ex.en: A slab of marble was used for the kitchen counter.
ex.zh: 廚房檯面用的是一整塊大理石板。

ex.en: America did away with slavery in 1863.
ex.zh: 美國在 1863 年廢除了奴隸制度。

ex.en: Lincoln was opposed to slavery.
ex.zh: 林肯反對奴隸制度。

ex.en: Slavery is a crime against humanity.
ex.zh: 奴役是危害人類的罪行。

ex.en: We must sleep at least eight hours a day.
ex.zh: 我們每天至少應該睡八個小時。

ex.en: I slept all day yesterday, because it was Sunday.
ex.zh: 昨天是星期天，所以我睡了一整天。

ex.en: He always leaves the window open while he sleeps.
ex.zh: 他睡覺時總是開著窗。

ex.en: I was at my best after a good sleep.
ex.zh: 好好睡一覺後，我的狀態最好。

ex.en: Lack of sleep can affect your mood.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足會影響情緒。

ex.en: The company's slogan is "Just Do It."
ex.zh: 這家公司的標語是「Just Do It」。

ex.en: Protesters shouted slogans outside the building.
ex.zh: 抗議者在大樓外高喊口號。

ex.en: Hasn't Huiru sent the slides yet? The client's pushing.
ex.zh: 慧如那個簡報檔還沒傳喔？客戶在催。

ex.en: Let's move on to the next slide.
ex.zh: 我們來看下一張投影片。

ex.en: The children slid down the bank.
ex.zh: 孩子們從河岸上滑了下去。

ex.en: The phone slid off the table.
ex.zh: 手機從桌上滑落。

ex.en: The kids took turns going down the slide.
ex.zh: 孩子們輪流溜滑梯。

ex.en: There's a big slide in the park.
ex.zh: 公園裡有一座大溜滑梯。
